jsonld_raw.name: SUNSET HOUR SELF-TANNING DROPS
jsonld_raw.description:
Achieve a natural and luminous tan with our Sunset Hour Self-Tanning Drops, specially formulated for the delicate skin of your face. Its nourishing blend of ingredients cares for your skin while allowing you to customize the intensity of the shade, achieving a golden, even, and streak-free finish.

Add a few drops to your usual moisturizer or serum, apply them to your face, and watch your skin progressively acquire a golden, soft, and healthy glow.

Simply mix a few drops with your usual moisturizer or serum, apply them to your face, and let your skin reveal, day after day, a golden, soft, and healthy glow.
